glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – cowrie used as currency in ancient China. Unrelated to the original version of 則. See also the top component of 得. Unrelated to 目.
s_page_origin: Simplified form of 貝 in cursive script.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 貝; s_page_origin explains the simplified 贝.
